title: 第787章 人性第786章 三大神通
slug: 长生家族从十七岁成为家主开始
lines: 花玉深吸一口气。
枯瘦的双手贴在石门上，猛地发力。
“轰隆隆！”
这扇尘封了不知多少岁月的石门，被缓缓推开。
一股腐朽的气息扑面而来。
岩魁眉头直皱。
他看向花玉：“第二祭司，圣女真的在这？”
“当然。”
花玉笃定道。
二人迈步踏入其中。
这是一座建造了不知多少年的古老地宫。
穹顶极高。
其上，镶嵌着一颗颗人头大小的幽绿晶石，散发着幽幽光亮。
两侧石壁上。
刻满了远古时期祭祀巫神的壁画。
在地宫正中央。
矗立着一尊高达十丈的青铜雕像。
雕像青面獠牙，生有三头六臂，浑身上下，缠绕着粗大的漆黑锁链。
每一只手里，都握着一件造型诡异的法器。
那三双空洞的眼睛俯瞰着下方，带着一种视苍生如蝼蚁的淡漠。
它，正是巫神殿所信奉的巫神。
在这尊压迫感十足的巫神雕像下方。
有一蒲团上。
蒲团上，静静盘坐着一个身影。
她面朝巫神，穿着一袭白色金丝祭袍，在这幽暗阴森的地宫中显得极其惹眼。
看着这个背影。
岩魁眼睛一亮。
他无比兴奋道：“第二祭司，是圣女！”
“她果然在这。”
花玉放声狂笑。
“天不亡我巫神殿！”
“大祭司，诸位先辈，你们看到了吗？”
“只要圣女在，只要巫神降临，那些贼子必死无疑！”
“巫神殿的道统，绝不会在我手中断绝！”
她向圣女走去。
岩魁跟在花玉身后。
眉头却皱做了一团。
他看着圣女背影，心中生出了一股莫名的寒意。
太安静了。
content_en:
Huayu took a deep breath.
His skinny hands pressed against the stone door and he exerted force.
"Boom!"
This stone door, which had been covered in dust for countless years, was slowly pushed open.
A smell of decay came to my face.
Yan Kui frowned.
He looked at Hua Yu: "Second Priest, is the saint really here?"
"Of course."
Huayu said firmly.
The two stepped into it.
This is an ancient underground palace built over an unknown number of years.
The dome is extremely high.
On it are inlaid green crystal stones the size of a human head, emitting a faint light.
On the stone walls on both sides.
It is full of murals dedicated to the witch gods in ancient times.
In the center of the underground palace.
There stands a bronze statue ten feet high.
The statue has a green face and fangs, has three heads and six arms, and is wrapped with thick black chains all over its body.
In each hand, there is a strange-looking magic weapon.
Those three pairs of empty eyes looked down, with a kind of indifference that looked at everyone like ants.
It is the witch god believed in by the witch temple.
Underneath this oppressive statue of the Witch God.
There is a futon on it.
On the futon, a figure sat quietly cross-legged.
She faced the Witch God, wearing a white gold silk sacrificial robe, which made her look extremely eye-catching in this dark and gloomy underground palace.
Look at this back.
Yan Kui's eyes lit up.
He said with great excitement: "The second priest is a saint!"
"She is indeed here."
Huayu laughed wildly.
"Heaven will not destroy my Witch Temple!"
"High Priest, ancestors, have you seen it?"
"As long as the Saint is here and the Witch God comes, those thieves will definitely die!"
"The orthodoxy of the Witch Temple will never be cut off in my hands!"
She walked towards the saint.
Yan Kui followed Hua Yu.
His brows furrowed.
He looked at the saint's back and felt an inexplicable chill in his heart.
It's so quiet.
